correctness.rationale: Proof establishes positive bounded solutions and exact critical Lyapunov dissipation; rank-one characteristic factor gives a simple eigenvalue zero and stable complement. Convolution with the slowly varying positive Perron mass gives the profile, then reciprocal scalar integration fixes amplitudes. Silent initial states admit an exact linear solution; three numerical archetypes and a silent example independently checked. Finite computations are not used for the universal quantifiers.
